description: This file defines the main route component for a notes management front-end application built with Qwik. It manages the UI layout, event bindings for note operations (create, update, delete, select, search), and integrates with custom hooks and components to facilitate notes handling.

methods.name: component$
methods.description: Main Qwik component that manages notes and layout.

methods.name: useVisibleTask$
methods.description: Sets up side effects and event listeners for note operations.

methods.name: onSearchChange$
methods.description: Handler for updating search query state.

methods.name: onCreate$
methods.description: Handler to create a new note.

methods.name: onSelect$
methods.description: Handler to select a note by ID.

methods.name: onUpdate$
methods.description: Handler to update a note with given ID and patch.

methods.name: onDelete$
methods.description: Handler to delete a note by ID.

methods.name: selected
methods.description: Computed function to get the currently selected note.
